events.title: Demo Out Now
events.summary: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For is a 2D puzzle-platformer which flips dying in video games on its head. In this game, your job in each puzzle room is to sacrifice all of your characters.That means that enemies, spikes and lasers which would be obstacles in most of games, can be used as tools here to achieve your goal.In the demo, you will explore parts of two islands and go through 9 puzzle rooms to reach the end.
